reasons: Classification is correct: Section 8.2's 180-day non-renewal notice window exceeds both the preferred (30 days) and fallback (≤60 days) thresholds and sits in walk-away territory (>90 days), so a deviation finding with a redline is warranted.

The redline reaches the preferred position with a targeted edit: notice window set to 30 days, the acceptable 12-month renewal term left intact, and a 60-day Vendor renewal reminder added as the preferred position expressly requires.
The advisory changed-character ratio (0.770) is explained by the added reminder sentence, which the rule's preferred wording calls for; no unnecessary rewriting of unrelated language occurred.
Correctly refrains from touching Section 8.3, which already caps renewal uplift at the lesser of CPI and 3% with no increase on prepaid periods — avoiding an over-flag of a compliant pricing term.
Comment is accurate, concise, in the required first-person-plural tone with the [Playbook] prefix, states what changed and why, and cites the 60-day fallback.
